minutes.headline: Planning Board approved an ANR and a stormwater permit, and continued the 43 Summer Street cannabis hearing to Aug 22.
minutes.summary: The Planning Board endorsed an ANR plan for 101 Pleasant Street, closed the hearing and approved the Northfield Road/Holmen Street stormwater permit with conditions including construction hours. The 43 Summer Street special permit hearing was continued to August 22 because of Mullin rule and attendance problems. The board also heard committee reports and director's items, and agreed not to hold its August 8 meeting.

public_comment.topic: Chair asked for public comment at the start; none was offered in the room.
Public comment on the stormwater permit was requested in the room and online; none was offered.
Public comment at the end: none, and no hands on Zoom.

budget_items.what_was_said: Grant funding came in via MRPC to work on MBTA infrastructure requirements; the town's match is the planner's time. A consultant is expected before the board in September.
The regional transportation group described a Safe Streets grant that would cover only part of a plan, with Lunenburg required to put up matching money.

decisions.decision: The board agreed not to hold the August 8 meeting, will not post it, and members will read the common driveway materials individually.
The applicant requested a continuance of the 43 Summer Street hearing to August 22 rather than August 8; the Mullin certificates are to be signed beforehand.
The planner will organize a 45-minute to one-hour Zoom meeting of chairs or representatives of the town boards about infrastructure and zoning on Chase Road.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the Northfield Road and Holmen Street stormwater permit 4-0 by roll call, with conditions including set construction hours.
The board voted 4-0 to accept the ANR plan for 101 Pleasant Street.
The 43 Summer Street special permit hearing was continued 4-0 to August 22 after Mullin rule and attendance problems.
The board agreed not to hold its August 8 meeting; members will read the common driveway materials on their own.
Committee reports covered a grant for MBTA Communities planning work and a Safe Streets grant that would require a town match.

why_it_matters: The stormwater permit conditions set construction hours for work near Northfield Road and Holmen Street, which affects neighbors there.
The 43 Summer Street hearing stays open, so the permit decision on that site has not been made and the public can still comment at the August 22 hearing.
The MBTA Communities work and the Safe Streets match both point to zoning and local-match decisions that residents may later be asked to vote on.
watch_next: The continued 43 Summer Street hearing on August 22 at 6:05 pm.
A consultant is expected before the board in September on MBTA Communities requirements.
